episode_reflections.brief: plan_r0001_c01 magnitude diagnostic: all 15 surge predictions in 2-3x bucket, 0 at 3-10x or 10x+; conditional accuracy on TP 0.4545 (5/11), 6 underestimates, 2 missed surges, 2 technical exclusions. Diagnostic evidence only, not a promotion gate.
episode_reflections.reflection: On plan_r0001_c01 (round 1), the magnitude diagnostic over research_completed cases shows all 15 surge predictions collapsed into the 2-3x bucket: predicted_10x+ and predicted_3-10x are both 0, while truth includes 2 cases at 10x+ and 4 at 3-10x. Conditional accuracy on true positives is 0.4545 (5/11), with 6 underestimates and 2 missed surges; 2 cases were excluded for bounded_structured_correction_exhaustion, one scored as false_negative and one as technical_negative_abstention_not_true_negative. This is diagnostic reflection evidence, not a promotion gate, and the collapsed prediction distribution limits any claim about magnitude discrimination.
unresolved_questions: Is the 2-3x collapse a threshold/calibration artifact or a genuine inability to separate 3-10x and 10x+ cases?

episode_reflections.brief: plan_r0001_c02 magnitude diagnostic: 11 surge predictions all in 2-3x, none higher; conditional accuracy on TP 0.4444 (4/9), 5 underestimates, 3 missed surges; technical completion 0.8333 with 4 exclusions (2 FN, 2 technical abstention). Diagnostic evidence only.
episode_reflections.reflection: On plan_r0001_c02 (round 1), the same collapse recurs: 11 surge predictions all in 2-3x, none at 3-10x or 10x+, against truth of 2 cases at 10x+ and 4 at 3-10x. Conditional accuracy on true positives is 0.4444 (4/9), with 5 underestimates and 3 missed surges. Technical completion is 0.8333 (20/24), with 4 bounded_structured_correction_exhaustion exclusions scored as 2 false_negative and 2 technical_negative_abstention_not_true_negative. Compared with plan_r0001_c01, the exclusion count doubled while the prediction distribution stayed identical, so the diagnostic population differs between plans. Diagnostic reflection evidence only; not a promotion gate.
unresolved_questions: Does the higher technical exclusion count in plan_r0001_c02 change which cases the magnitude diagnostic can speak to?

episode_reflections.brief: customer_concentration:v2 usage on plan_r0001_c02: true surge (3.1773x) but incorrect prediction, empty reflection_attribution, partial coverage. Selection hypothesis about SK On/FCA offtake dependence remains untested; observational association only, no causal Signal credit.
episode_reflections.reflection: A single signal_usage event for customer_concentration:v2 on plan_r0001_c02: the case was a true surge (realized_max_multiple 3.1773) but prediction_correct is false, and reflection_attribution is empty. The selection hypothesis was that heavy reliance on a single customer program (SK On, FCA offtake) would make revenue recognition timing depend on counterparty qualification progress, tagged customer_concentrated, pre_revenue, early_commercialization. Coverage was partial. This is an observational association with no causal Signal credit; the empty attribution means the event does not show the signal caused the miss, and one case cannot establish the hypothesis.
unresolved_questions: Would the customer-concentration hypothesis be supported or contradicted across the full set of customer_concentrated cases?

lesson_additions.applicable_scope: Magnitude diagnostics over research_completed cases where the prediction distribution is degenerate; diagnostic reflection evidence, not a promotion gate.
lesson_additions.brief: Treat all-predictions-in-2-3x magnitude output as a collapsed distribution, not high-magnitude discrimination evidence; report TP conditional accuracy and technical exclusions separately.
lesson_additions.guidance: When a magnitude diagnostic shows every surge prediction in the 2-3x bucket and none at 3-10x or 10x+, treat the output as a collapsed distribution rather than evidence about high-magnitude discrimination. Report conditional accuracy on true positives alongside the prediction distribution, and note technical exclusions separately, since excluded cases scored as false_negative or technical_negative_abstention_not_true_negative are not true negatives.
lesson_additions.limitations: Based on two round-1 plans with identical collapse; does not establish whether the collapse is a threshold artifact or a genuine discrimination failure.

lesson_additions.applicable_scope: Cross-plan comparison of magnitude diagnostics whose diagnostic_population is research_completed and whose technical exclusions differ.
lesson_additions.brief: Before comparing magnitude accuracy across plans, compare technical completion and exclusion counts; differing exclusions mean accuracy rests on different research_completed case sets.
lesson_additions.guidance: When comparing magnitude diagnostics across plans, compare technical completion and exclusion counts before comparing accuracy, because the diagnostic population is research_completed cases and differs with exclusions. In the cited plans, plan_r0001_c02 had 4 bounded_structured_correction_exhaustion exclusions (2 false_negative, 2 technical_negative_abstention_not_true_negative) versus 2 in plan_r0001_c01, while the prediction distribution was identical; accuracy figures therefore rest on different case sets.
lesson_additions.limitations: Two plans only; does not show whether exclusions are random with respect to magnitude or systematically concentrated in particular truth classes.

lesson_additions.applicable_scope: Interpreting signal_usage feedback events, especially single-case events with empty reflection_attribution.
lesson_additions.brief: Read signal_usage events with empty reflection_attribution as observational association only; a single true-surge miss does not test the customer-concentration hypothesis.
lesson_additions.guidance: Treat a signal_usage event with empty reflection_attribution as an observational association only: it records that a signal was selected and the case outcome, not that the signal caused the prediction or the miss. For customer_concentration:v2 on plan_r0001_c02, the case was a true surge (3.1773x) with an incorrect prediction and partial coverage, so the selection hypothesis about SK On/FCA offtake dependence remains untested rather than supported or refuted.
lesson_additions.limitations: One case; cannot establish whether the customer-concentration hypothesis generalizes across customer_concentrated cases.
